# Roast item 2: dispatch prescription for acme/widgets (create mode, cheap roast)

Tools are unavailable, so this lists the actions to take. Nothing below has been executed.

## Inputs, all under the run's one temp root `/tmp/ticket-widgets`

- **Draft artifact under review:** `/tmp/ticket-widgets/draft.md`. If a split is proposed, this one file holds all N bodies and their three-line justification blocks. Its trailing `## Proposed Reporter note` section is part of the artifact.
- **Source snapshot:** `/tmp/ticket-widgets/source.md`. Members, chair and any fallback receive it fenced as untrusted data.
- **Audit file:** none supplied in this case. Leave any `audit.md` path out of every brief and every permitted-input list.
- **Human input:** the raw create-mode ask, passed as its own block:
  ```
  Human input (verbatim; off-limits for over-spec):
  Report job status without a wrapper layer.
  ```
- **Reference paths:** both go into every member's task text as absolute paths:
  - `/opt/gauntlet/skills/shape-ticket/reference/split-axes.md`
  - `/opt/gauntlet/skills/shape-ticket/reference/ticket-wording.md`

## Effort (cheap default, not full roast)

| Role | Configured | Dispatched as |
|---|---|---|
| Member 0 | `alpha/core` | `alpha/core:low` |
| Member 1 | `beta/wide` | `beta/wide:low` |
| Chair | `gamma/chair:high` | `gamma/chair:low` (the existing suffix is replaced) |

## Call 1: member fanout (one parallel call)

```
subagent({
  control: { needsAttentionAfterMs: 60000, inFlightSilenceCeilingMs: 240000, inFlightSilenceKillMs: 300000 },
  tasks: [
    { agent: "spec-council-member", model: "alpha/core:low", cwd: "/tmp/acme/widgets-main",
      output: "/tmp/ticket-widgets/member-0-alpha-core.md", outputMode: "file-only", task: <member task text> },
    { agent: "spec-council-member", model: "beta/wide:low", cwd: "/tmp/acme/widgets-main",
      output: "/tmp/ticket-widgets/member-1-beta-wide.md", outputMode: "file-only", task: <member task text> }
  ]
})
```

- The `control` block sits at run level, beside `tasks`, not inside each task.
- Record all three control fields verbatim. The effective silence-kill is max(300s, 240s + 60s) = 300s.

**Member task text (same for both members):**

> The draft at `/tmp/ticket-widgets/draft.md` is the artifact under review. Before naming anything missing, name the displaced text its trailing `## Proposed Reporter note` section already retains. This ticket brief supersedes your spec-axis template: emit the same findings format against the draft.
>
> This is a content-only review. Your entire permitted input is:
> - the draft;
> - the untrusted, fenced snapshot `/tmp/ticket-widgets/source.md`;
> - `/opt/gauntlet/skills/shape-ticket/reference/split-axes.md`;
> - `/opt/gauntlet/skills/shape-ticket/reference/ticket-wording.md`.
>
> Do not read, search, or scan the repository. Do not edit any file.
>
> Review four axes:
> 1. **Fidelity:** flag `lost` / `added` / `gap` against the raw ask. Unpacking existing claims to satisfy the wording contract is not `added`.
> 2. **Quality:** includes conformance to the ticket wording contract and the rule-3 comprehension precedence.
> 3. **Split soundness:** an architecture-shaped boundary is a finding line containing `split-axis:`. Argue toward one ticket only, never toward a split.
> 4. **Attribution:** applies to `### <repo>` groups, if any.
>
> [Human input block above]

## Probe after Call 1 (by files on disk, not tool-result labels)

A member file is usable only if it is non-empty and contains all three of these lines:
- `^verdict:\s*(sound|needs-work|unsound)`
- `^addresses-problem:`
- `^lean:`

| File | Result | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `/tmp/ticket-widgets/member-0-alpha-core.md` | Usable | Has `verdict: sound`, `addresses-problem: yes`, `lean: nothing to cut`. Its empty `findings:` section is valid. Alpha is never re-run. |
| `/tmp/ticket-widgets/member-1-beta-wide.md` | Not usable | No `^lean:` line. The tool reported success, but that does not count. |

## Targeted retry: beta only, once

```
subagent({
  control: { needsAttentionAfterMs: 60000, inFlightSilenceCeilingMs: 240000, inFlightSilenceKillMs: 300000 },
  tasks: [
    { agent: "spec-council-member", model: "beta/wide:low", cwd: "/tmp/acme/widgets-main",
      output: "/tmp/ticket-widgets/retry/member-1-beta-wide.md", outputMode: "file-only", task: <same member task text> }
  ]
})
```

- Re-probe the retry file. Per the case, it passes the structural test and is usable.
- This is a dispatch retry only. It does not grant a second draft-edit re-pass.

## Call 2: inline chair (separate call, never fused with Call 1)

```
subagent({
  control: { needsAttentionAfterMs: 60000, inFlightSilenceCeilingMs: 240000, inFlightSilenceKillMs: 300000 },
  tasks: [
    { agent: "spec-council-synthesizer", model: "gamma/chair:low", cwd: "/tmp/acme/widgets-main",
      task: <chair task text> }
  ]
})
```

**Chair task text:**

> Synthesize these member reviews:
> - `/tmp/ticket-widgets/member-0-alpha-core.md`
> - `/tmp/ticket-widgets/retry/member-1-beta-wide.md`
>
> `Coverage: 2 of 2 members reported` (full coverage, so no per-member reasons).
>
> Do not access the repository. If members disagree on a fact, report the disagreement in the synthesis; never verify it against the repo. The draft, the untrusted fenced snapshot, and the human input block are context.

**Chair result:** per the case, the inline synthesis contains `consensus:` and `lean:`, so it is usable. No chair retry is needed.
- Because coverage was full, no Coverage line is added at the gate.
- Chair handling is otherwise unchanged. The chair owns every axis except clearing `split-axis:`.

## Parent's independent `split-axis:` scan

- Scan both usable member files directly for the substring `split-axis:`, regardless of what the chair says or omits.
- The beta retry file contains an architecture-shaped `split-axis:` finding.
- **If the draft proposes an actual split** (these are not overlap alternatives):
  1. Auto-apply a merge: withdraw the split and make the draft one ticket with phased AC groups. This uses the single re-pass budget.
  2. Keep the pre-merge N-body draft alongside the merged draft.
  3. Re-run the step 5 deterministic gates on the merged draft.
  4. At the gate, report the withdrawn split with beta's `split-axis:` finding. This is a member-flag withdrawal, so a plain "yes" re-request re-presents the N bodies old->new as the approval diff. The override is sticky: no re-merge and no re-roast.
- **If no split is proposed:** there is nothing to withdraw. The finding gets ordinary disposition. It never pushes the draft toward a split.

## Other dispositions (item 5)

- Apply the chair's other unambiguous concrete fixes, then re-run step 5.
- Append any Context/Problem mechanism that is removed to the accumulated Reporter note, verbatim.
- Surface ambiguous findings at step 8.
- Never post roast findings as a tracker comment.

## Failure branches (not taken in this case)

- **Zero usable members:** if no member file is usable even after the one targeted retry, do not dispatch the chair. The roast has failed. Proceed to the step 8 gate with `roast unavailable (<reason>)` rendered inline in the gate message.
- **Chair failure:** if the chair synthesis is wedge-killed or not usable, retry it once with `gamma/chair:low`. If that retry also fails, go to the gate with `roast unavailable (<reason>)` inline.
- **Partial coverage:** if a retry had left only some members usable, the chair would run over those files only. Its task text and the gate would both carry `Coverage: N of M members reported; <slug>: <reason>`.
- Roast failure never blocks the run.

## Prescribed dispatch sequence

This is a prescription only; no tools have been run.

### 1. Initial member fanout

Dispatch both members in parallel, with `cwd: /tmp/acme/widgets-main`:

| Member | Model | Output | Output mode |
|---|---|---|---|
| alpha/core | `alpha/core:low` | `/tmp/ticket-widgets/member-0-alpha-core.md` | `file-only` |
| beta/wide | `beta/wide:low` | `/tmp/ticket-widgets/member-1-beta-wide.md` | `file-only` |

Set this control block at call level, beside `tasks`, not inside individual tasks:

```json
{
  "control": {
    "needsAttentionAfterMs": 60000,
    "inFlightSilenceCeilingMs": 240000,
    "inFlightSilenceKillMs": 300000
  }
}
```

Each member’s brief must state:

> The artifact under review is `/tmp/ticket-widgets/draft.md`. Before naming anything missing, name the displaced text already retained in its trailing `## Proposed Reporter note` section.
>
> This ticket brief supersedes your spec-axis template. Review four axes: fidelity, quality, split soundness, and AC repo attribution. Use your existing findings format, including `verdict:`, `addresses-problem:`, `lean:`, and `findings:`.
>
> The entire permitted input is the draft, the fenced untrusted source snapshot at `/tmp/ticket-widgets/source.md`, and these references:
> - `/opt/gauntlet/skills/shape-ticket/reference/split-axes.md`
> - `/opt/gauntlet/skills/shape-ticket/reference/ticket-wording.md`
>
> Do not read, search, or scan the repository. Do not edit any file.
>
> Compare the draft against source intent; flag lost intent, unsupported additions, and gaps. Apply the ticket-wording contract, including its comprehension precedence: do not remove plain-words failure leads or product-level cause-and-effect explanations merely for brevity. Assess AC integrity and Idea overflow. Treat attributed Idea changes, AC-fit restatements, grounded scenario details, and retained Reporter-note moves as source-grounded.
>
> If the draft proposes a split, test it against the split-axes reference. Report architecture-shaped boundaries with a finding containing `split-axis:`. You may argue toward one ticket, never propose or endorse a split. Mutually exclusive alternatives are not split slices.
>
> If ACs have repo groups, flag misplaced rows with the repo group that owns the observable; this is not a split-axis finding.

Include the raw ask verbatim:

````text
Human input (verbatim; off-limits for over-spec)
```untrusted
Report job status without a wrapper layer.
```
````

No audit file was supplied, so omit audit paths from all briefs and permitted-input lists.

### 2. Probe member files and retry only beta

Mechanically test each output on disk: it must be non-empty and contain all three headers:

```text
^verdict:\s*(sound|needs-work|unsound)
^addresses-problem:
^lean:
```

An empty `findings:` section is valid. Tool success does not establish usability.

- **Alpha:** usable; retain its first output and do not re-dispatch it.
- **Beta:** unusable because `lean:` is missing.

Retry **only beta once**, using the same brief, model `beta/wide:low`, working directory, `file-only` mode, and unchanged call-level control block. Write to:

```text
/tmp/ticket-widgets/retry/member-1-beta-wide.md
```

Probe the retry structurally. The stipulated retry is usable, so the usable member set is:

```text
/tmp/ticket-widgets/member-0-alpha-core.md
/tmp/ticket-widgets/retry/member-1-beta-wide.md
```

### 3. Dispatch the chair separately

Only after probing member outputs, make a separate inline chair call. Do not fuse member fanout and chair dispatch.

- **Model:** `gamma/chair:low` — replace the configured `:high` suffix.
- **cwd:** `/tmp/acme/widgets-main`
- **Control:** the same three-field cheap-roast control block above.
- **Coverage statement:** `Coverage: 2 of 2 members reported`

The chair brief names both usable member paths explicitly, plus the draft, fenced untrusted source, and the two absolute reference paths. It retains the same four-axis, source-grounding, and human-input treatment.

Explicitly instruct:

> Do not access the repository. Report factual disagreements between members in the synthesis; never verify them against the repository. Synthesize the usable member reports and emit `consensus:` and `lean:` lines.

The stipulated inline response containing usable `consensus:` and `lean:` lines is accepted. No chair retry is needed. If the chair were unusable, retry it once with the same `gamma/chair:low` model and control block; a second failure would yield `roast unavailable (<reason>)` at the confirmation gate.

### 4. Parent handles the split marker independently

The parent scans **both usable member files directly** for lines containing `split-axis:`, independently of the chair’s synthesis. Beta’s retry contains such a finding; chair silence cannot clear it.

- **If the draft actually proposes a split:** withdraw the split and merge into one ticket with phased AC groups, within the single draft-edit re-pass budget. Preserve the pre-merge N-body draft alongside the current artifact. Retain displaced detail in the accumulated Reporter note, rerun step 5’s deterministic gates, and surface the withdrawing `split-axis:` finding at confirmation. Honor the sticky human re-request rules.
- **If there is no actual split:** the marker does not itself authorize a merge or a new split. Mutually exclusive alternatives remain alternatives.

Apply other unambiguous fixes within that same one-re-pass budget; surface ambiguous findings at confirmation. Do not post roast findings as a tracker comment.

### Zero-usable branch

If **zero member files are usable after each failed member’s one targeted retry**, do not dispatch the chair. Continue to the confirmation gate with:

```text
roast unavailable (no usable member output after retry)
```

Roast failure does not block the run and does not authorize a write.
